This means that when training the base PPO agent (or any DRL agent) on HalfCheetah, observations should be normalized. vec_norm = VecNormalize(
```python
    vec_env,

    norm_reward=normalize_reward,
    gamma=gamma,
)
```

The variable `normalize_obs` is obtained via `agent_config.get("normalize_obs", True)`, so when the HalfCheetah-specific config specifies `normalize_obs: true`, observations will indeed be normalized during training. This implementation correctly satisfies the requirement that observations are normalized when training a DRL agent on the HalfCheetah-v3 environment.
